newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SOCCER-SUTTER TURNS DOWN OFFER TO REJOIN SWISS SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-SUTTER TURNS DOWN OFFER TO REJOIN SWISS SQUAD.

text.p: Alain Sutter, one of Switzerland's most experienced internationals, has turned down an invitation to rejoin the national squad for its World Cup qualifying match against Norway on Nov. 10.
According to Swiss newspaper reports on Monday, the Fribourg midfielder, capped 61 times, gave no explanation for his decision simply responding, "no" to coach Rolf Fringer's offer.
"I think Alain is not ready yet to make the commitment or have the will to play again for the national team," said Fringer. "I must accept his decision even if I don't understand it."
Dropped from the Swiss squad for last summer's European championship by then coach Artur Jorge, Sutter vowed never again play for the national team.
